final: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(1.0*HGB/NULLIF(HCT,0)) AS r FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING r IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a1 FROM p), k AS (SELECT p.ID, p.r, p.r - o.a1 AS d1 FROM p, o WHERE p.r > o.a1), s AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a2 FROM k) SELECT AVG(k.r) AS avg_ratio, AVG(k.d1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(k.r - s.a2) AS avg_above_second FROM k, s WHERE k.r > s.a2
